intro_section.title: Explore Beyond el Mangroove Hotel
paragraphs: El Mangroove is a contemporary luxury resort on the Gulf of Papagayo, approximately 30 to 40 minutes from Liberia airport (LIR). Its beachfront setting, multi-bedroom villas and design-forward approach make it a natural base for families, groups and adventure-minded travelers looking to explore Guanacaste's national parks and natural landmarks.

Wild Papagayo organizes private tours with direct pickup from el Mangroove Hotel. Every experience departs from and returns to the resort, with no shared buses, no other travel groups and no fixed schedule to follow.

Day trips range from about eight to twelve hours in Costa Rica's cloud forests, wildlife reserves, volcanic landscapes and national parks. Exact pickup time is confirmed after booking based on your selected experience and travel date.

featured_tours.title: Six Private Tours from el Mangroove Hotel

tours.note: Encounter sloths in their natural habitat with a certified naturalist guide. Lunch included. Sightings are frequent but not guaranteed. About 8 hours.
Selvatura suspension bridges, butterfly garden and interactive coffee plantation tour in Monteverde Cloud Forest. Breakfast and lunch included. About 12 hours.
Walk the treetops of Monteverde Cloud Forest along a guided suspension trail with panoramic forest views. Breakfast and lunch included. About 12 hours.
Las Pailas Trail through fumaroles and mud pots at Rincón de la Vieja. Classic (waterfall) or Plus (hot springs) options. About 8 hours. Runs Tuesday through Sunday — park closed Mondays.
Full-day hike to Río Celeste at Tenorio Volcano National Park. Swimming is not permitted in the river. Park entrance fee included. About 9 hours. Minimum age 8.
Three cascading waterfalls, volcanic mud treatment and natural hot springs at Miravalles Volcano. Lunch and all entrance fees included. About 8 hours.

audience_sections.title: Private Tours for Families at el Mangroove Hotel
audience_sections.intro: El Mangroove's multi-bedroom villas — from two-bedroom to four-bedroom options up to 4,500 square feet — make it one of the more practical bases in Papagayo for family travel. Wild Papagayo private tours extend that experience into Guanacaste's national parks and wildlife areas, with no shared buses and no other groups joining yours.

groups.title: Wildlife Days
groups.text: Sloth Adventure Tour and Hanging Bridges & Sloths are both popular with families for wildlife encounters, easy forest walks and suspension bridges — a genuinely different day from beach time at the resort.

groups.title: Cloud Forest Days
groups.text: Monteverde Hanging Bridges & Coffee Tour and Monteverde Treetop Walk take families into the cloud forest for bridge walks, butterfly gardens and an introduction to Costa Rica's coffee culture. Breakfast and lunch included on both.

groups.title: Active Days
groups.text: Rincón de la Vieja Hiking is suitable for families with older children who want a full day in a volcanic national park. Celeste River Hike is recommended for minimum age 8.

audience_sections.title: Private Day Trips for Adventure Travelers at el Mangroove
audience_sections.intro: El Mangroove's adventure access score is among the highest of any hotel in the region. Wild Papagayo extends that into Guanacaste's volcanic parks and jungle reserves — private, guided, with hotel pickup.

groups.title: Volcanic Landscapes
groups.text: Rincón de la Vieja Hiking and Miravalles Volcano Waterfalls & Spa both explore active volcanic terrain — fumaroles, mud pots, waterfalls and thermal water — on full-day guided experiences.

groups.title: River & Forest
groups.text: Celeste River Hike at Tenorio Volcano National Park is a full-day moderate hike through primary forest to one of Costa Rica's most photographed natural landmarks.

groups.title: Wildlife & Nature
groups.text: Sloth Adventure Tour and Monteverde Treetop Walk round out the program for adventure travelers who want biodiversity and forest immersion over pure adrenaline.

faq.q: Can Wild Papagayo arrange pickup directly from el Mangroove Hotel?
faq.a: Yes. Wild Papagayo coordinates direct hotel pickup from el Mangroove on the Gulf of Papagayo. Exact pickup time is confirmed after booking based on your selected tour and travel date.

faq.q: What private tours are available from el Mangroove Hotel?
faq.a: Six tours are featured in this guide: Sloth Adventure Tour, Monteverde Hanging Bridges & Coffee Tour, Monteverde Treetop Walk, Rincón de la Vieja Hiking, Celeste River Hike and Miravalles Volcano Waterfalls & Spa. All include direct hotel pickup.

faq.q: How far is el Mangroove Hotel from Liberia Airport?
faq.a: El Mangroove is approximately 30 to 40 minutes by private transfer from Guanacaste Airport (LIR) in Liberia.

faq.q: Is el Mangroove Hotel suitable for families?
faq.a: Yes. El Mangroove offers multi-bedroom villas from two to four bedrooms, including a four-bedroom villa of approximately 4,500 square feet — a practical option for families and larger groups.

faq.q: How long is the drive from el Mangroove to Rincón de la Vieja?
faq.a: As general Gulf of Papagayo area planning context, approximately 93 to 118 minutes each way. Actual travel time depends on road conditions and the specific pickup location. The hiking tour takes about 8 hours and runs Tuesday through Sunday, as the national park is closed on Mondays.

faq.q: Are tours from el Mangroove Hotel private?
faq.a: Yes. Every Wild Papagayo experience is reserved exclusively for your group. No shared buses, no other travelers added to your group.

faq.q: What are the best tours from el Mangroove for adventure travelers?
faq.a: Rincón de la Vieja Hiking and Celeste River Hike are both recommended for adventure-focused guests. Miravalles Volcano Waterfalls & Spa combines volcanic terrain with a spa day if you want something less strenuous but still immersive. All three include direct hotel pickup.
